mentions.name: Local video game rental platform
mentions.description: A local platform for renting out and renting video games, designed to make gaming affordable where buying games is very expensive. It scales up an informal rotation of games among friends and friends-of-friends into a broader community rental service.
mentions.problem: Buying video games is very expensive, and gaming is an expensive hobby in general where the builder lives.
mentions.audience: Making gaming affordable in a place where buying games is very expensive and gaming is an expensive hobby generally.
mentions.source_excerpt: Nothing fancy, building a local platform to rent/rent-out video games.

evidence.value: Nothing fancy, building a local platform to rent/rent-out video games.
